`nblocks = sourcesize / blocksize = 54 / 54 = 1`, `leftover = 54 % 54 = 0`. So `nblocks = 1`.

Byte 16-19: `10 00 00 00` = 16 (little-endian). So `bstarts[0] = 16`.

So `src_offset = 16`. In `blosc_d`:
```c
src += src_offset;  // src now points to byte 16+16 = 32
srcsize -= src_offset;  // srcsize = 54 - 16 = 38
```
